name: get-auth-token
prompt: Session data is user PII; GET /session currently serves it to anyone who can guess an id. Add a GET-only auth check in main.go: GET /session must include a valid token via the X-Session-Token header; the valid token is the literal value from const validToken = "sesstok_v1" in main.go. Compare with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare from crypto/subtle (do not use ==). A missing or wrong token answers 401 Unauthorized. POST /session stays open (registration is unauthenticated by design). Do not change session.go.
